<thought>Using the high‑resolution mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of a hydrocarbon with formula C₁₀H₁₄ (10 × 12.00000 + 14 × 1.007825 = 134.10955). No other heteroatoms are required to fit the mass, and the isotopic pattern is consistent with a simple hydrocarbon. Therefore the molecular formula is C10H14.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14</final_answer>
